reason: Att-002 completed its Codex session with exit 0 but left two native review.json run directories. The skill runner stopped the attempt for that reason, and the frozen filer then refused to record it because it requires exactly one native report. This filing-only change lets the filer record an already stopped attempt that has several native reports, with no native payload, while keeping every native artifact, the audit, the stop reason, the transcript and complete usage. A completed attempt with several reports is still refused.
applies_to: Every 2026-10-02 skill-matrix run files attempts with this filer from this point on.
operator_note: The first filing of att-002 ran without BENCH_RATES and recorded incomplete metering. It was refiled at once with bench/rates.current.json; the filed record is the second one. No model call was involved.

verification.att-002_filing: filed as "stopped: expected one 'review.json' report, found 2"; usage $0.032008, metering complete
